mapping.positions: Treatment occupies A for two judges and B for one judge; assignment pseudorandomized at dispatch using a run-secret seed.
mapping.custody: Mapping exists only in coordinator artifact, not in judge artifacts, and is not committed to repository before judgments.
mapping.reveal: Only after valid J01/J02/J03 raw judgments are hash-sealed.

independence: Each judge runs in a fresh context.
Judge receives only its own packet.
No Project/GitHub search, prior chat, hidden plan, state ledger, internal scores, other judge output, or model/candidate identity.
First complete schema-valid judgment is preserved; unfavorable scores are not rewritten.

packet.whole: Two complete screenplay surfaces labeled SCRIPT A and SCRIPT B.

gates.absolute: Mapped Treatment: >=2/3 judges whole mean >=7.0 and surface mean >=7.0; no critical violation confirmed by >=2 judges.
gates.paired: Mapped Treatment surface preference wins >=2/3; whole preference wins+ties >=2/3.
gates.focus: Pooled mapped Treatment median not below Control on DIALOGUE_SUBTEXT, CHARACTER_VOICE, PHYSICALIZATION_ACTION, KOREAN_SPOKEN_NATURALNESS; >=4 of 6 focus axes show median delta >=+0.5.
gates.recoverability: Treatment premise, major threads, nine movements, relationship trajectories, due/deferred boundary must be recoverable by >=2/3 judges at core-consensus level.

claim_boundary: Directional provider-analog rehearsal because historical Control is 35,333 chars and Treatment is 40,568 chars; not clean causal proof or actual API equivalence.
